name: @taalcut/website
description: taalcut.app: the static marketing site (Next.js, exported), with the waitlist on Firestore. Imports no Taalcut package.

scripts.build: node scripts/brand-assets.mjs && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && node scripts/csp.mjs
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.26.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-taalcut --config firebase/firebase.template.json "vitest run firebase/test"
scripts.e2e: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && playwright install --only-shell chromium && playwright test
scripts.e2e:waitlist: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=127.0.0.1:8183 NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && playwright install --only-shell chromium && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.26.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-taalcut --config firebase/firebase.template.json "NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=127.0.0.1:8183 playwright test test/e2e/waitlist.spec.ts test/e2e/waitlist-forms.spec.ts test/e2e/contact.spec.ts test/e2e/platforms.spec.ts"
